Scout Boom

Custom Order

The Scout Boom is a deployable camera mechanism for capturing visual inspection data and "selfies" of the satellite in orbit.

Request Quote View Specs

The Scout Boom system uses stored strain energy to deploy a bistable composite or flexible polymer boom rolled compactly against the CubeSat.

Features an integrated flex PCB running along the boom length for the camera module, eliminating complex wire harnesses and reducing snag risks.

Camera Integration Off-the-shelf Module via Flex PCB
Deployment Method Stored Strain Energy
Form Factor Compatible with 1U+
Stowed Dimensions 50 x 40 x 38 mm (incl. HDRM)
Extended Length Up to 1.5 m
System Mass < 150g (w/ Camera)
Max Tip Mass 40g (at 70cm length)
Camera Resolution 5 MP (Typical)
Data Interface MIPI CSI-2 / USB
Power 3.3V / 150mW
Actuation (HDRM) Burn Wire (Solder Pads + Feedback)
TRL 4 (Functional Prototype)

Connection Interfaces:

  • Standard: Solder Pads (Resistors) + Pico-Lock Connector (Data/Feedback).
  • High-Reliability: Harwin Gecko/Datamate (Integrated Power & Data) available on request.

Electrical Specs:

  • Actuation (Release): Burn Wire / Resistor.
    Recommended Drive: 5V @ 2A (current-limited) for < 2s.
  • Feedback (Status): Limit Switch.
    Dry contact closure upon full deployment (Normally Open).
